title: Elijah Will Come
old_p1: At the end of his book, Malachi wrote the Lord’s promise: “I will send you Elijah the prophet.”
Elijah lived long ago and was taken up to heaven. A prophet speaks for Heavenly Father.
Elijah would “turn the heart of the fathers to the children,” and the children’s hearts to their fathers. That means families now would love their families of long ago.
old_p2: In 1836, Elijah came! He stood before the prophet Joseph Smith and his friend Oliver Cowdery in the Kirtland Temple. Elijah gave them power from Heavenly Father to join families together forever in temples.
Your family can be together forever too. Tonight, as you snuggle in, think of everyone in your family, and your grandparents too.
p1: At the end of his book, Malachi wrote a promise. The Lord said, “I will send you Elijah the prophet.”
Elijah had taught Heavenly Father’s words long before. Then he was taken up to heaven.
Elijah would “turn the heart of the fathers to the children.” Children’s hearts would turn to their fathers too. Families now would love their families from long ago.
p2: In 1836, Elijah came! He stood before Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery in the Kirtland Temple. He gave them Heavenly Father’s power to join families together forever in temples.
Your family can be together forever too. Tonight, as you snuggle in, think of your family, even great-grandparents long ago.

p2_christian: Later, an angel spoke of John the Baptist. John would come “in the spirit and power of Elias.” Elias is Elijah. John would turn fathers’ hearts to their children. He helped people get ready for Jesus.
Heavenly Father wants families to love each other. Tonight, as you snuggle in, think of your family, even great-grandparents long ago.
